row.accessibilityMe: Rank {{rank}}, {{name}}, {{xp, number}} XP. This is you.

empty.title: Nobody has scored yet
empty.body: The board resets every Monday. Answer a few questions and you will be the first name on it.

error.title: Could not load the leaderboard
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

guest.title: Guests are not ranked
guest.body: Create an account to keep your progress and take your place on the weekly board.

no-name.title: Choose a display name
no-name.body: The board shows a name, not an email address. Pick one and you are in.

hidden.title: You are hidden from the leaderboard
hidden.body: You are still earning XP and levels — you just do not appear in the ranking. You can change this in Profile.

no-xp.title: No XP yet this week
no-xp.body: The board covers this week only. Finish a lesson and your name appears.

name.title: Display name
name.body: This is the only thing other learners see of you. Your email address is never shown.
name.label: Display name
name.hint: {{min}} to {{max}} characters. Letters, numbers, spaces, and . _ -

problem.too_short: A bit longer, please — at least 3 characters.
problem.too_long: That is too long. Keep it to 20 characters.
problem.invalid_characters: Use letters, numbers, spaces, and . _ - only.
problem.reserved: That name is reserved. Please pick another.
problem.not_allowed: That name is not allowed. Please pick another.
problem.taken: Someone already has that name. Try a different one.
problem.unknown: That name could not be saved. Please try again.

report.title: Report this name
report.body: Tell us what is wrong with "{{name}}" and we will review it.
report.notePlaceholder: A short note helps us review it faster
report.thanks: Thanks — we will take a look.
report.failed: The report could not be sent. Please try again.

settings.title: Leaderboard
settings.noNameHint: Needed to appear on the weekly leaderboard
settings.hideDescription: You keep every point, level and achievement — your name just does not appear in the ranking.
settings.hideFailed: That setting could not be saved. Please try again.
settings.hideMinor: Learners under {{age}} are always hidden from the leaderboard. You still earn every point, level and achievement.
